preconditions.description: Number of cities n is between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities within the range [1, n].

postconditions.description: The number of days k is greater than zero.

postconditions.expression: sum(d_i for d_i in days) == n - 1
postconditions.description: The total number of roads repaired over all days equals n - 1.

postconditions.expression: all(len(day) == d_i for day, d_i in zip(days, d_ies))
postconditions.description: Each day has exactly d_i roads scheduled for repair.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= road <= n - 1 for day in days for road in day)
postconditions.description: Each road number in the schedule is within the range [1, n - 1].

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(day)) == len(day) for day in days)
postconditions.description: No road is scheduled for repair more than once on any single day.
